issues.claim: add covariate groups one at a time (Sentinel-2, soil/terrain maps, any EM38/EM31 or field-sensor data)

sources.quote: Probali smo da koristimo satelitske NDVI snimke kao vodič za adaptivno uzorkovanje, ali nismo imali dobre rezultate jer se salinitet ne vidi jasno na vegetacionim indeksima u ranom proleću.

issues.explanation: The company already tried satellite vegetation indices as an adaptive-sampling guide and reports they failed because salinity is not visible in early-spring indices; the plan reintroduces Sentinel-2 covariates without acknowledging that failure or stating which season/composite should be used. Add this as a known risk and specify that Sentinel-2 covariates are tested with non-early-spring (e.g. autumn) composites and must beat the 4-ha baseline before inclusion.
